about: A bot's voice settings when the voice list can't be fetched. Staged: voice is set to a Chatterbox server through the app's own config route, and the page's fetch answers the voice list with a 503. The call screen's Set up voice, where these settings open in the app, needs the desktop speech engine, so the same VoiceSettings is opened from the repo's bot settings test page (Defaults for new bots > Voice & alerts).

steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/state/api.ts'); await m.api('/api/config', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ tts: { provider: 'chatterbox', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:9/' } }) }); return true; })()
